decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is still central to the firm's binding mobile communication strategy and costs little to keep, though its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 weakens the signal of its value.
As a platform-level architecture underpinning the other security offers, it preserves many follow-on options, so keeping it is justified even with less visibility.

Four years after launch and with no visibility since 2019, the standalone mobile PDF signing feature has likely shown its value is limited, so its resources are better folded into the broader online contract signing development.
Payment compliance demand is persistent and regulation-driven, so the option still holds plausible value despite weak recent visibility, but it is a candidate for review.
